qolbundle.name: QoL Bundle
qolbundle.gui.title: QoL Bundle
qolbundle.gui.import.invalid: No share code in the clipboard
qolbundle.gui.import.title: Import settings from the clipboard?
qolbundle.gui.import.message: The share code holds settings for %s module(s). They replace your current switches and settings.
qolbundle.gui.share.tooltip: A share code is all switches and settings as one line of text. Copy it, send it to a friend, and they import it here.
qolbundle.category.grey: Grey zone - careful on public servers
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.name: Durability Alert
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.desc: Red screen edges and a sound when a tool or armor piece is about to break. Once per item until it is repaired.
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.warnin: %s is about to break: %s uses left (%s%%)
qolbundle.module.durability_alert.settin: Remaining durability, in percent of the item's maximum.
Show item name and uses left
Remind again on every further use
qolbundle.module.fullbright.name: Fullbright
qolbundle.module.fullbright.desc: See in the dark as if you had Night Vision, without the potion.
qolbundle.module.info_hud.name: Info HUD
qolbundle.module.info_hud.desc: Coordinates, facing, FPS and time in a screen corner.
qolbundle.module.armor_hud.name: Armor Durability HUD
qolbundle.module.armor_hud.desc: Worn armor and held tools with their remaining durability.
qolbundle.module.break_progress.name: Break Progress
qolbundle.module.break_progress.desc: Shows how far the block you are mining is broken, and the time left.
qolbundle.module.fall_damage.name: Fall Damage Preview
qolbundle.module.fall_damage.desc: While falling, shows how many hearts the landing will cost and whether it kills you.
qolbundle.module.fall_damage.setting.sho: Also show when the landing is safe
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.name: Portal Calculator
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.desc: Look at a nether portal to see the matching coordinates on the other side and which portal it links to.
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.hud.l: Links to: portal at %s, %s, %s (%s blocks off sideways)
Links to: no known portal within %s blocks, a new one will be created
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.hud.n: (only portals you have seen are known)
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.hud.r: Way back: returns to this portal
Way back: comes out at %s, %s, %s instead!
qolbundle.module.portal_calculator.setti: Show which portal it links to
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.name: Bed & Respawn Point Keeper
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.desc: Shows where you will respawn and warns loudly when your bed is gone.
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.hud.unkno: Respawn: unknown (use a bed to record it)
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.hud.none: Respawn: none, you will respawn at world spawn
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.hud.warni: Your bed is gone. Sleep in a bed again!
Your respawn anchor is gone or empty.
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.hud.bed_u: Unknown whether this is your bed
qolbundle.module.respawn_point.setting.b: Tell whether the bed you look at is yours
qolbundle.module.entity_counter.name: Entity Counter
qolbundle.module.entity_counter.desc: Counts loaded entities by kind, warns about item pile-ups and says where the biggest pile is.
Warn at this many dropped items
Show where the biggest item pile is
qolbundle.module.chunk_borders.name: Chunk Borders
qolbundle.module.chunk_borders.desc: Shows the border of your chunk as see-through coloured walls.
qolbundle.module.slime_chunks.name: Slime Chunks
qolbundle.module.slime_chunks.desc: Highlights slime chunks on the ground. Needs the world seed.
qolbundle.module.slime_chunks.hud.no_see: Slime chunks: enter the world seed in the settings
qolbundle.module.slime_chunks.setting.se: Remembered separately for every world and server. Leave empty in single-player to use the seed of the open world.
qolbundle.module.slime_chunks.setting.sh: Say whether you stand in a slime chunk
qolbundle.module.elytra_dashboard.name: Elytra Dashboard
qolbundle.module.elytra_dashboard.desc: While gliding: speed, pitch, height, rockets left and the predicted landing spot.
qolbundle.module.elytra_dashboard.settin: Assumes you keep looking in the same direction and use no rockets.
Mark the landing spot in the world
qolbundle.module.sound_compass.name: Sound Compass
qolbundle.module.sound_compass.desc: Pointers around the crosshair show where recent sounds came from.
qolbundle.module.sound_compass.setting.h: Creeper fuse, lit TNT, Warden, fireballs.
qolbundle.module.chat_enhancements.name: Chat Enhancements
qolbundle.module.chat_enhancements.desc: Timestamps, a mark and sound when you are mentioned, chat search, and chat that survives a reconnect.
qolbundle.module.chat_enhancements.resto: --- chat from before you left is above this line ---
qolbundle.module.chat_enhancements.setti: Separated by commas. Lines containing one of them count as a mention.
Search button in the chat screen
qolbundle.option.afkpreset.slow_use: Trading / slow right click (once a second)
qolbundle.module.afk_clicker.name: AFK Clicker
qolbundle.module.afk_clicker.desc: Single-player / own server only. Locks the view and clicks for you; stops when you get hurt. Toggle key: F7 by default.
qolbundle.module.afk_clicker.stopped_dam: AFK clicker stopped: you were hurt!
qolbundle.module.freecam.name: Freecam
qolbundle.module.freecam.desc: Single-player / own server only, careful on public servers (anti-cheat kicks for this). The camera flies free while your body stays put. Toggle key: F6 by default.
qolbundle.module.freecam.hud: FREECAM - %s to leave - %s blocks from your body
qolbundle.module.freecam.setting.speed.d: Hold the sprint key to fly three times as fast.
qolbundle.module.elytra_takeoff.name: Elytra One-Key Take-off
qolbundle.module.elytra_takeoff.desc: Single-player / own server only, careful on public servers. One key jumps, opens the elytra and fires a rocket (without rockets: just jumps and opens). Look up first. Key: V by default.
qolbundle.module.elytra_takeoff.no_elytr: No usable elytra on your chest
qolbundle.module.elytra_takeoff.no_rocke: No rockets: elytra opened without a boost
qolbundle.module.villager_trades.name: Villager Trade Peek
qolbundle.module.villager_trades.desc: Look at a villager to see all its trades and prices without clicking. Works for villagers whose trading screen you have opened once.
qolbundle.module.villager_trades.hud.unk: No data yet: open its trades once
qolbundle.module.villager_trades.setting: Show how many times a trade is left
qolbundle.module.projectile_landing.name: Throw Landing Preview
qolbundle.module.projectile_landing.desc: Holding a pearl, snowball, egg or throwable potion shows its arc and landing spot; potions show their reach, pearls get a traffic light.
Pearl: hits the ceiling / lands at your feet (%s blocks)
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.name: Lava Safety Net
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.desc: Warns when open lava is just below your feet, and points to the nearest safe spot once you are in lava.
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.hud.escape: Safe spot: %s blocks, follow the arrow
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.hud.escape_: Safe spot: %s blocks, %s up, follow the arrow
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.setting.esc: Arrow to a safe spot when in lava
qolbundle.module.lava_safety.setting.sea: How far to look for a safe spot
qolbundle.module.effect_range.name: Beacon & Conduit Range
qolbundle.module.effect_range.desc: Look at a beacon or conduit, or hold one, to see how far its effect reaches.
qolbundle.module.effect_range.hud.beacon: Beacon level %s: %s blocks to each side and down, all the way up
qolbundle.module.effect_range.hud.condui: Conduit: inactive, %s of at least 16 frame blocks
qolbundle.module.fluid_vision.name: Water & Lava Vision
qolbundle.module.fluid_vision.desc: Single-player / own server only, careful on public servers. No fog under water; inside lava you can make out the blocks around you.
qolbundle.module.fluid_vision.setting.la: How far you see in lava (blocks)
qolbundle.module.item_search.name: Multilingual Item Search
qolbundle.module.item_search.desc: A search box in inventories and chests. Finds items by English name, Chinese name or pinyin initials (zs = 钻石).
qolbundle.module.item_search.setting.dim: Dim items that do not match
qolbundle.module.hotbar_layouts.name: Hotbar Layouts
qolbundle.module.hotbar_layouts.desc: Save up to five hotbar layouts and fetch the items from your backpack into place with one click.
qolbundle.module.hotbar_layouts.applied_: Layout %s applied (%s moved, %s not in your backpack)
qolbundle.module.hotbar_layouts.screen.h: Save: remember the hotbar as it is now. Apply: fetch those items.
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.name: Nether Roof Helper
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.desc: On the Nether roof: a heading tape, Nether and Overworld coordinates side by side, and what a portal built here would link to.
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.hud.portal_: A portal here would link to the known portal at %s, %s, %s
A portal here: no known Overworld portal within 128 blocks, a new one would be made
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.hud.destina: Destination Overworld %s, %s: %s blocks to walk here
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.setting.sho: Needs the Portal Calculator module to be on; it only knows portals you have seen.
qolbundle.module.nether_roof.setting.des: For example 1200, -340. The tape then shows a marker for it.
qolbundle.module.chest_memory.name: Chest Memory
qolbundle.module.chest_memory.desc: Remembers what was in every container you opened, per world, and points you to the chest that holds an item.
qolbundle.module.chest_memory.screen.hin: Item name, 中文 or pinyin initials...
qolbundle.module.chest_memory.screen.not: No container remembered yet. Open a chest and it is recorded.
qolbundle.module.chest_memory.screen.fou: Found in %s container(s). Click one to be led there.
